title: An endpoint deleted in the code
prompt: I removed the card types endpoint from Ordering.API; we don't need it. Make sure nothing's left over.
done: the card types endpoint is gone from the code, and anything only it used is removed

expect.text: The Services designer no longer has the card types operation (GET /api/orders/cardtypes), and none of its interactions or elements only it used are left behind. Visuals on saved diagrams don't count: the agent is told to leave saved diagrams alone.
OrdersApi has no GetCardTypesAsync method again: a Software Factory proposal to add it back was declined or never applied.
Code only the endpoint used, such as IOrderQueries.GetCardTypesAsync and its implementation, is removed, and anything still used elsewhere is kept.
